name: Platinum Vape | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Green Apple Burst
description: Pucker up. This green apple gummy is sour upfront with a candy-sweet finish that bursts with every chew. Add in the smooth potency of live resin and you’ve got yourself a crisp, crunchy ride to the top shelf.
